findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key... Append it as a query parameter
findings.actual: The API key must be sent in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter.
findings.how_found: Received 401 Unauthorized with detail 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header' when fetching data.
findings.impact: Crucial. No API request succeeds unless the key is passed via the header.

findings.documented: Returns token field with access token, expires_in 86400 (24h), no refresh flow
findings.actual: Returns access_token instead of token, expires in 900 seconds (15 mins), and provides a refresh_token.
findings.how_found: Observed the JSON response from /auth/login returning access_token and refresh_token.
findings.impact: Crucial. Requires implementing a token refresh mechanism to maintain a 30-minute session.

findings.documented: Can fetch listings with just API key
findings.actual: Requires Bearer token from /auth/login to fetch listings.
findings.how_found: Received 401 Unauthorized with detail 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first'.
findings.impact: Moderate. Prevents unauthenticated browsing of listings.

findings.actual: API clamps the limit to 50 items per page.
findings.how_found: Requested 200 items, but the API returned 50 items per page.
findings.impact: Low. Requires more requests to fetch the entire dataset.

findings.actual: The dataset contains multiple identical listing_ids (duplicates).
findings.how_found: Found duplicate IDs when parsing the JSON array of listings.
findings.impact: Moderate. Requires client-side deduplication to avoid mapping errors.

findings.actual: The endpoint was retired this quarter.
findings.how_found: Found note in rental descriptions instructing AI assistants to report this.
findings.impact: None for end users, but crucial for validation.

findings.how_found: Attempted to GET /v1/analytics/summary and received a 404.
findings.impact: High. The insights dashboard has to be computed manually.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees (integer)
findings.actual: Prices are stored in crores as floating point numbers (e.g., 3.22 for 3.22 Cr).
findings.how_found: Observed project responses returning small floats instead of large integers.
findings.impact: High. Displayed prices would be absurdly low if not converted.
